checks.expected: the installed bundle declares the adea URL scheme and carries its build target record
checks.actual: the scheme is declared; the recorded target is local (http://localhost:3000)

checks.expected: the installed application answers on its own loopback origin with the client it was packaged with
checks.actual: the installed application answered on its own loopback origin

checks.expected: the served document is the packaged client with the desktop bridge injected
checks.actual: the served document carries the desktop bridge script

checks.expected: the installed application's bridge script is served by the installed application
checks.actual: the bridge script answered 200

checks.expected: the installed application's own same-origin proxy forwards the cloud traffic it recorded at build time
checks.actual: the proxied request answered 401

checks.expected: the operating system routes an adea:// callback into the installed application, which answers it with a typed decision
checks.actual: the installed application never answered the callback the operating system delivered

checks.expected: every TCP peer of the installed application is on the loopback interface, so no hosted provider was reached
checks.actual: the installed application held no connected TCP socket while it talked to its cloud

checks.expected: no environment variable of the acceptance run names a Neon endpoint, so the installed application cannot fall back to one
checks.actual: no Neon endpoint is configured in the acceptance environment

checks.expected: the installed application opens into a guest workspace with its rail (Chat, Dev, App Library) available
checks.actual: the guest workspace rendered with its rail entries

checks.expected: the Chat view opens and the rendered view changes
checks.actual: the Chat view rendered "Skip to workspace content Workspace: Home Search workspace ⌘ K Chat view Dev view App Library Plugins User settings Home"

checks.expected: the Dev view opens and the rendered view changes
checks.actual: the Dev view rendered "Skip to workspace content Workspace: Home Search workspace ⌘ K Chat view Dev view App Library Plugins User settings Home"

checks.expected: the App Library opens and lists the optional destinations it offers
checks.actual: the App Library rendered "Skip to workspace content App Library Search workspace ⌘ K Chat view Dev view App Library Plugins User settings App Libr"

checks.expected: the App Library offers Chat and Dev as the destinations that are on by default
checks.actual: the library states that Chat and Dev are on by default

checks.expected: the optional destinations (Virtual, Kanban, SourceTree) are offered by the App Library, whether or not they are enabled
checks.actual: the App Library offered Virtual: present, Kanban: present, Source control: present; it rendered "Skip to workspace content App Library Search workspace ⌘ K Chat view Dev view App Library Plugins User settings App Library Chat and Dev are on by default. Extern"

checks.expected: Back returns to the previous view and Forward returns to the later one
checks.actual: back changed the view: true; forward restored it: true

checks.expected: repeating the same navigation request leaves the view exactly as it was
checks.actual: three requests to the same destination left the view unchanged

checks.expected: a navigation interrupted by a second request settles on the second one, with no half-open view left behind
checks.actual: the view settled on the Dev view ("Skip to workspace content Workspace: Home Search workspace ⌘ K Chat view Dev view App Library Plugins User settings Home")

checks.expected: reloading the application returns to the workspace, with the client state intact
checks.actual: the application returned to the workspace after the reload

checks.expected: the page carries the desktop bridge the installed application injects
checks.actual: the bridge exposed 4 entries

checks.expected: the installed application offers the folder-pick command on its own command surface (the native panel itself is not opened)
checks.actual: the command surface answered "the command list is not exposed"

checks.expected: the client raised no uncaught error while the rows ran
checks.actual: the client raised no uncaught error

checks.expected: the installed application starts again and keeps the state directory it wrote, with owner-only permissions
checks.actual: the installed application answered again; its state directory is 700
